summary.zhCn: Dogecoin 共同创建者、前四版客户端开发者；约2014—2015年退出早期维护，后来参与基金会顾问与内容创作。
summary.en: Dogecoin co-creator and developer of its first four releases; left early maintenance around 2014–2015, later taking part in Foundation advising and publishing.
